beats.care: Expect evening and late-night showers. Avoid known waterlogging spots like Vyasarpadi and Besant Road when commuting.
beats.what: Chennai averaged 3.42 cm of rain in 24 hours to 6 am Saturday. Perambur got the most, 8.79 cm, then Madhavaram at 8.70 cm.
beats.why: The northeast monsoon is active. RMC Chennai's VR Durai said widespread heavy rain is likely across Tamil Nadu till October 26.

cards.body: GCC Commissioner G S Sameeran checked Aranganathan Subway, sumps and storm drains in Saidapet. Teams cleared silt from catch pits on Besant Road in Teynampet.
